title: Personal Vibe Coding Portfolio Website
subtitle: Created my own multi-page portfolio website telling my web development journey
summary: Created my own multi-page portfolio website from the ground up through vibe coding—featuring a dark, calligraphic editorial aesthetic inspired by PostGeneric, JSON-driven content architecture, and an embedded high-thinking prompt studio.
challenge: Most developer portfolios either look like generic templates or require editing raw JSX every time a new project or blog post is added. I wanted a bold, dark, calligraphic portfolio that tells my authentic story from Tamil Nadu while keeping every piece of content cleanly separated in JSON data files.
solution: Using Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini for initial research and prompt synthesis—and building/hosting directly inside Google AI Studio—I architected a 5-page + journal application where projects, timeline milestones, and blog posts load dynamically from JSON files. It pairs Cormorant Garamond calligraphic typography with subtle cubic-bezier motion.
vibePromptUsed: Build a multi-page portfolio website that tells the story of my web development journey through vibe coding. Style: modern, animated, dark and techy with bold calligraphic typography and PostGeneric-inspired kinetic transitions. Keep all projects, timeline entries, and blog posts in JSON data files with clean, commented code.
highlights: 100% decoupled JSON content layer for projects, timeline entries, and journal posts
PostGeneric-inspired kinetic typography, marquee ribbons, and compositor-only scroll reveals
Dynamic per-page SEO title, meta description, OpenGraph tags, and XML sitemap
Clean, heavily commented codebase designed for continuous learning and readability

title: Vibe Prompt & Content Synthesis Blueprint
subtitle: Structured research-to-deployment workflow across Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini
summary: A repeatable prompt engineering system I created to research domain requirements, structure content, and draft high-precision build prompts before launching full-stack prototypes in Google AI Studio.
challenge: Jumping straight into code generation with vague ideas leads to messy layouts and broken logic. During hackathons, clarity of thought is the difference between a stalled repo and a deployed product.
solution: I designed a 3-stage prompt pipeline: first using ChatGPT and Gemini for competitive research and content structuring, then Claude for semantic architecture refinement, and finally executing and hosting the build inside Google AI Studio.
vibePromptUsed: Act as a principal web architect. Given my raw hackathon concept, output: 1) Core user journey in 3 steps, 2) JSON schema for all dynamic content, 3) Accessibility & SEO checklist, and 4) A single deterministic build prompt for Google AI Studio.
highlights: Reduces initial boilerplate and setup time by over 80% during hackathons
Enforces semantic HTML, accessible keyboard navigation, and mobile responsiveness from turn one
Integrated live inside this portfolio's Toolkit page via Gemini High-Thinking mode

title: Flow-State Hackathon Starter Architecture
subtitle: Zero-boilerplate semantic web patterns for 24-hour rapid prototyping
summary: A curated collection of accessible, dark-mode layout patterns, breadcrumb navigators, and JSON data loaders built to turn raw hackathon ideas into deployed reality before momentum fades.
challenge: In a hackathon, spending four hours wiring navigation headers, mobile drawers, and form validation drains creative momentum before you even touch the core problem.
solution: I distilled my favorite editorial layout structures—responsive headers, breadcrumb trails, lightbox viewers, and validated forms—into clean, commented modules that I can adapt in minutes.
vibePromptUsed: Create a modular, accessible dark-mode web layout with shared header, mobile hamburger menu, breadcrumb navigation, and smooth page transitions using only compositor-friendly CSS transforms.
highlights: Sub-200ms interaction feedback using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) settling curves
Full keyboard navigation and screen-reader friendly ARIA landmarks
Designed for instant cloud deployment via Google AI Studio
